scope: No training, no validation selection. Frozen original experts/upstream; actual top4 renormalized mixtures through final down module, sampled dev/validation positions. Native probabilities and scalar-calibrated probabilities reported separately with same native top4 indices. Rounding affects only gate inputs with experts/hidden fixed and FP32 kernels. Serial router+topk timing on shared GPU, not end-to-end throughput. Test remains reserved.
selector_protocol: Originalgate top4 on logits before softmax; probability-output candidates top4 on native probability. Indices computed on the inference device and carried through calibration and CPU storage. v1 retained as protocol-failure evidence; no retraining.
